rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something extremely large.

example.english: This room is enormous; it can fit two tables.
example.traditional: 呢間屋好大，擺得落兩張枱。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 uk1 hou2 daai6 baai2 dak1 lok6 loeng5 zoeng1 toi2

rows.note: Use this for enormous quantities, budgets, organizations, or overall scale rather than mainly physical dimensions.

example.traditional: 呢項工程涉及龐大資金。
example.jyutping: ni1 hong6 gung1 cing4 sip3 kap6 pong4 daai6 zi1 gam1
